Package com.nexuslink.protocol.redis

Class RedisReplyOutput

java.lang.Object
io.lettuce.core.output.CommandOutput<String,String,Object>
com.nexuslink.protocol.redis.RedisReplyOutput
public final class RedisReplyOutput extends io.lettuce.core.output.CommandOutput<String,String,Object>
Collects any Redis reply into plain Java objects — the output the console needs to send a command the client has never heard of and still print what came back.

Lettuce's built-in outputs are shaped for one reply type each (StatusOutput for simple strings, IntegerOutput for integers, NestedMultiOutput for arrays), and its general-purpose ObjectOutput throws UnsupportedOperationException on a top-level scalar in RESP2 — which is most replies. This output accepts them all: simple and bulk strings and nulls become String, integers Long, doubles Double, booleans Boolean, and arrays, sets, pushes and maps become nested Lists.
